title: Household Energy Telemetry
description: A basic household or community energy telemetry payload for the Phase 1 production foundation.

community_id.description: Unique community or flexibility group identifier.

device_id.description: Unique device identifier inside the household or community.

device_type.description: Device category, for example smart_meter, battery, ev_charger, heat_pump, or solar_inverter.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp for when the measurement was produced.

readings.description: Named telemetry readings. A reading can be a number or an object with value and optional unit.

protocol.description: Transport used to receive the telemetry.

source.description: Source system, gateway, simulator, or connector that sent the telemetry.
